description: Embedded application/format catalog, exposed by both client and server.

api_protocols.description:
Understood HTTP protocol identifiers (`api/v{n}`), kept beside `protocol` during
the transition.

application_version.description:
Shared workspace release identity; display, update checks and `blocked_versions`
only. Never compared as a range.

blocked_versions.description: Known-bad application versions refused regardless of markers.

database_write_formats.description: Complete database formats this application can write.

features.description:
Optional capabilities `{name: revision}`. A function is used only when both
sides declare it at the same revision; a missing one never refuses sync.

marker_revision.description:
Present on marker-based peers (0.7.2+). Absent: the peer predates markers and
must upgrade (Compatibility_Markers.md §4).

migration_source_schemas.description: Supported owned-conversion schema sources, not permission to mutate them.

migration_target_format.description: Format produced by a successful Plan B conversion.

minimum_sqlite_version.description:
Display/diagnostics only; each side checks its own linked SQLite at startup
([`check_linked_sqlite`]).

peer_application_ranges.description:
Declared for peers still doing range checks (they ignore markers); never used
for decisions here.

protocol.description: Supported API protocol interval; peers are compatible when intervals intersect.

snapshot_read_formats.description: Complete snapshot format identifiers the application can read.

title: CompatibilityManifest
